repo_notes.content: supastack is a provider-neutral AI SaaS starter kit shipped as a pnpm + turbo monorepo. apps/web is a Next.js 16 application (App Router, strict TypeScript) that carries the whole product surface; apps/mobile is an Expo app that consumes the web app's BFF routes; apps/desktop is a Tauri webview shell over the web app; apps/docs holds documentation tooling. The 15 packages under packages/ are framework-neutral contracts and adapters selected at runtime by environment switches: AI_PROVIDER (fake|openai|anthropic|openai-compatible|openrouter), AGENT_FRAMEWORK (ai-sdk|mastra|langgraph|openai-agents), BILLING_PROVIDER (local|stripe|lemonsqueezy|creem|polar|whop|paddle|dodo|paypal), EMAIL_PROVIDER (local|resend|ses|postmark|sendgrid|mailgun|smtp|brevo), JOB_PROVIDER (local|trigger), STORAGE_PROVIDER (memory|s3), CUSTOM_DOMAINS_PROVIDER (off|local|cloudflare), AUTH_PROVIDER (better-auth|authjs). Every user-owned record is scoped by workspaceId — never trust a workspace id from the client. Provider secrets stay server-only. The kit ships a customization library (theme packs, design styles, layout variants, copyable kit blocks, agent prompts) rather than a fixed look. Workspace tools are defined once in a shared registry and exposed to both agent runners (@supastack/agents) and the stateless MCP server at /api/mcp. Billing adapters all implement one BFF contract over a shared entitlement ledger. Emphasize the env-switch provider pattern, workspace scoping, and the web app as the source of truth that mobile and desktop project.
repo_notes.author: supastack

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Monorepo layout (apps + packages), the env-switch provider pattern, workspace scoping, and how web/mobile/desktop relate.

pages.title: Web Application
pages.purpose: apps/web: Next.js 16 App Router structure, server composition root, server actions, route groups, and locale-prefixed routing.

pages.title: Mobile Application
pages.purpose: apps/mobile: Expo app structure, navigation, and how it consumes the web app's API surface.

pages.title: Desktop Shell
pages.purpose: apps/desktop: Tauri webview over the web app, Rust-side window/tray/hotkey behavior, SUPASTACK_APP_URL selection.

pages.title: Shared Packages
pages.purpose: packages/* overview: framework-neutral contracts, adapter pattern, and which env switch selects each package's implementation.

pages.title: Operations & Deployment
pages.purpose: Deployment topology, environment configuration, scripts, and operational tooling at the repo root.

pages.title: Auth & Sessions
pages.purpose: Better Auth/Auth.js engines (packages/auth), OAuth providers, OTP, session handling, dynamic trusted origins for custom domains, workspace membership.

pages.title: AI Routing, Budgets & BYOK
pages.purpose: ModelRouter, catalog aliases (fast/smart/cheap), entitlement and budget enforcement, BYOK key vault with encrypted provider credentials (packages/ai).

pages.title: Public REST API & API Keys
pages.purpose: /api/v1 BFF, sk_ API keys, scope model, rate limiting, idempotency keys, error envelope (packages/api contracts).

pages.title: MCP Server
pages.purpose: POST /api/mcp: stateless Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, sk_-key-only auth, scope-filtered workspace tools, shared tool registry.

pages.title: Billing Providers & Entitlement Ledger
pages.purpose: Checkout/portal flows, webhook verification per provider, and the shared entitlement ledger that gates paid features.

pages.title: Settings & Workspace Administration
pages.purpose: Settings sections (general, appearance, security, billing, members, domains, notifications, developers, audit), org actions, admin surface.

pages.title: Custom Domains & White Label
pages.purpose: Cloudflare for SaaS custom hostnames, workspace_domain records, DNS/DCV verification, request branding, trusted origins.

pages.title: Theming, Blocks & Layouts
pages.purpose: Theme packs, design styles, density/radius/font axes, layout variants, the copyable kit block library, marketing theme mode.

pages.title: SEO & Marketing Surface
pages.purpose: Metadata, sitemap/robots, JSON-LD, OG image routes, docs/blog resources, apps/docs tooling.

pages.title: Internationalization
pages.purpose: Locale routing (en/de/es/fr), dictionary structure in packages/i18n, localized emails and page copy.

pages.title: Email & Transactional Delivery
pages.purpose: Transactional sender contract, provider transports via the email SDK, React Email templates, mail preview, separation from outreach.

pages.title: Webhooks & Outbound Events
pages.purpose: Outbound webhook registry, event types, signing, delivery records, workspace-scoped subscriptions.

pages.title: Server Configuration
pages.purpose: packages/config: zod-parsed env schema, per-provider credential requirements, public vs server config separation.

pages.title: Database, Schema & Migrations
pages.purpose: packages/db: Drizzle schema, workspace-scoped tables, migrations, postgresClientOptions pooler handling.

pages.title: AI Provider Layer
pages.purpose: packages/ai: provider contract, fake/openai/anthropic/openai-compatible/openrouter implementations, usage accounting.

pages.title: Agent Framework Adapters
pages.purpose: packages/agents: shared tool definitions, ToolContext, and the ai-sdk/mastra/langgraph/openai-agents adapters loaded lazily.

pages.title: Billing Adapter Contracts
pages.purpose: packages/billing: the provider-neutral checkout/portal/webhook contract implemented by stripe, lemonsqueezy, creem, polar, and whop.

pages.title: Email Transports
pages.purpose: packages/email: EmailSender contract, resend/ses senders, and email-sdk transports for postmark/sendgrid/mailgun/smtp/brevo with telemetry off.

pages.title: Jobs & Background Work
pages.purpose: packages/jobs: JobRunner contract (enqueue/status/cancel only), local runner, Trigger.dev adapter semantics.

pages.title: Object Storage
pages.purpose: packages/storage: workspace-prefixed object keys, memory and S3-compatible adapters, Supabase/MinIO endpoint support.

pages.title: UI Packages & Design Tokens
pages.purpose: packages/design-tokens, ui-web, ui-native: shared tokens and component primitives consumed by web and mobile.

pages.title: Observability
pages.purpose: packages/observability plus Sentry/PostHog wiring: error capture, analytics boundaries, secret redaction.

pages.title: Mobile BFFs & Native Purchases
pages.purpose: Mobile-specific backend-for-frontend routes and the RevenueCat boundary — native purchases never hit Stripe Checkout.

pages.title: Supabase Deployment
pages.purpose: supabase:provision and supabase:doctor scripts, pooler modes and prepared statements, RLS hardening, cloud and self-hosted paths.
